name: Guardian Paragon Smash is castable while Heavy Blow is on cooldown (#13728)
contract: Paragon 706514 grants 1 stack of 706516 (10 s) on block and 3 stacks on casting Heavy Blow; at 10 stacks it
applies 707138 (DurationIndex 1 = 10000 ms) and replaces Heavy Blow (Category 1087, RecoveryTime 10000 ms)
with Paragon Smash 802629 (Category 737, RecoveryTime 10000 ms, 8 yd AoE). Previously
spell_ascension_guardian_ability::Check rejected 802629 with SPELL_FAILED_NOT_READY whenever any Heavy Blow
rank had a remaining cooldown, making Paragon Smash uncastable for the entire 10 s duration of 707138 whenever
Heavy Blow triggered the 10th stack (and whenever blocks reached 10 stacks during Heavy Blow's 10 s cooldown).
With 7 stacks of 706516, casting active Heavy Blow Rank 9 (503126) starts Heavy Blow's 10 s cooldown, adds 3
stacks to trigger 707138 and replaces 503126 with 802629; after the 1.5 s GCD, while 503126 still has >5 s
cooldown remaining, Paragon Smash 802629 must cast cleanly, damage both nearby enemies, consume 707138, set
Heavy Blow's cooldown, and return the replacement to 503126. Pre-existing on main: Synchronize() removes
802629 via Player::removeSpell(..., true) once 707138 is consumed, which strips triggered aura 803432 on the
next update; that behavior is unrelated to #13728 and is not asserted here.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Equip main-hand weapon for Heavy Blow
Equip shield in off hand
Learn Heavy Blow Rank 9 (503126)
Learn Paragon (706514)
SETUP: Paragon passive aura is active
Fixture 7 Paragon stacks before Heavy Blow
CONTROL: Heavy Blow is not replaced before 10 stacks
Cast Heavy Blow to add 3 stacks and trigger Paragon Smash while starting Heavy Blow's 10 s cooldown
SETUP: Heavy Blow cast succeeded
SETUP: Heavy Blow reached 10 Paragon stacks and applied Paragon Smash aura 707138
SETUP: 706516 stack aura cleared on proc
SETUP: Heavy Blow is replaced by Paragon Smash 802629
Wait past Heavy Blow's 1.5 s GCD while Heavy Blow's 10 s cooldown is still active
SETUP: Heavy Blow is still on cooldown (> 5000 ms remaining)
DISCRIMINATING: Cast Paragon Smash while Heavy Blow is still on cooldown
DISCRIMINATING: Paragon Smash cast is accepted (not rejected with SPELL_FAILED_NOT_READY)
DISCRIMINATING: Paragon Smash hits primary nearby target
DISCRIMINATING: Paragon Smash hits second nearby target in AoE
Paragon Smash consumes ready aura 707138
Heavy Blow cooldown is set to Paragon Smash recovery time after cast
Replacement returns to Heavy Blow once 707138 is consumed
